Samir Goyal: Hey everyone — I’m Samir, just joined as a Solutions Engineer (Berlin, remote). I’m a huge fan of mechanical keyboards, climbing, and late-night pancakes. Stoked to be here! :wave:
Ava (People Ops): Welcome Samir!! :tada: Quick heads up — you’re on EMEA standup rotation (9:30 CET). Badge will be waiting at reception tomorrow morning. DM me if you need anything.
Jenna (Eng): Welcome!! Climbing partner? Also, we have a tiny keyboard-clack corner on Fridays. :keyboard:
Mike (Infra): Hey Samir — welcome aboard. I’ve got a random box of spare keycaps in eng-infra if you want to customize. Shipping for a monitor arm + dock goes out today.
Samir Goyal: Thanks y’all — appreciate it. Climbing partner most-def. Also — important question: boba or coffee? :bubble_tea: :coffee:
Ava (People Ops): Quick poll: react with :coffee: if you want office coffee, :bubble_tea: for boba vouchers, :tea: for tea, :droplet: for still water. We’ll stock accordingly.
Lina (DevEx): Any desk plant allergies we should know about? We love plants but want to avoid sneezing coworkers. :seedling:
Samir Goyal: Cactus please (low maintenance). Allergic to heavy florals.
Samir Goyal: timezone: CET (UTC+1). Prefers calendar invites between 9:00-16:00.
Ops-bot: New hire checklist: welcome_email=sent, slack_account=active, laptop_provision=status:queued.
Marcus Rey: Welcome again, Samir — excited to pair next week on onboarding tasks. Ping me any time. :slightly_smiling_face:
